notes: National Rail (Darwin/OpenLDBWS) is structurally catalogued here but blocked at the account level - DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN not set. Same blocker as every other UK region in this wave.

TWO independent National Rail station groups, no single hub-lock: Glasgow Central (GLC) and Glasgow Queen Street (GLQ) are separate buildings, not rail-connected, serving genuinely different corridors. Do not collapse into one board. See docs/glasgow-d1/jim-handoff.md ('Option A at n=2').

Neither National Rail group needs internal doNotGroup (no evidence of separate platform/boarding-section logic per operator, unlike london-se-national-rail's London Bridge/Liverpool Street) - each is a single flat departure board, destination + operator.
CRS codes GLC/GLQ are carried from the oracle report and NOT independently verified against a live GTFS dump or Darwin response (crsVerified: false).

Glasgow Subway (SPT): a TRUE CIRCULAR LINE WITH NO TERMINI, hub-locked at Buchanan Street. Direction model is printed Outer Circle / Inner Circle labels, not line+terminus - see lib/cities/glasgow/subway-directions.js and docs/glasgow-d1/direction-model-memo.md. No confirmed GTFS-RT feed exists for SPT. Static GTFS is a community aggregation (TravelWhiz, GB-Bus-Train-Metro-GTFS), not an official SPT feed - CC BY 4.0 covers TravelWhiz's own curation, license confidence 'unclear' on whether the underlying SPT timetable data may be redistributed via a public API.

Subway stop order is UNVERIFIED - the 'stations' array in lib/cities/glasgow/subway-directions.js is transcribed from the oracle report's table order, not confirmed against an official SPT map or the TravelWhiz GTFS stop_sequence. Jim's D2 attempt found the TravelWhiz GitHub repo reachable but no confirmed per-region data file/release path within this session's scope - carried forward unverified, not guessed. See lib/providers/glasgow.js GlasgowSubwayFeedUnverifiedError.

doNotGroup: Buchanan Street (Subway) vs Glasgow Queen Street (National Rail, GLQ) - travelator-connected but separate station entities/operators/infrastructure. St Enoch (Subway) vs Glasgow Central (National Rail, GLC) - short walk only, not connected. See lib/cities/glasgow/subway-directions.js DO_NOT_GROUP_PAIRS.
Falkirk High (FKK) is EXCLUDED - owned by the Edinburgh region per the exclusive-territory split (Tim's decision, oracle report line 11/91). Not catalogued here at all.
Caledonian Sleeper is EXCLUDED at Glasgow Central - board-eligibility verdict out-reservation (compulsory berth booking, no walk-up boarding).

lat/lng superseded 7 Sep 2026 (uk-catalog-geocode) — the oracle report itself gave no coordinate source, but NaPTAN carries confirmed stop-level coordinates for both National Rail (RailReferences, CRS-keyed) and Glasgow Subway (StopType MET, ATCO prefix 9400ZZGL / "SPT Subway Station" suffix); see the Coordinates note below.

Does not connect by rail to Glasgow Central.
